subtitle: Lesson 13 · Linux Fundamentals I — The Shell & Filesystem

code:
$ sudo useradd -m -s /bin/bash jsmith
$ sudo passwd jsmith
$ sudo groupadd developers
$ sudo usermod -aG developers jsmith

$ groups jsmith
jsmith : jsmith developers
caption: -m creates the home dir, -s sets the shell, -aG appends a group without removing others.

code:
$ ls -l deploy.sh
-rwxr-xr--  1 jsmith developers 812 deploy.sh

$ chmod 755 deploy.sh
$ ls -l deploy.sh
-rwxr-xr-x  1 jsmith developers 812 deploy.sh
caption: Owner, group, everyone else — each checked as its own r/w/x triplet.

code:
$ sudo chown jsmith:developers deploy.sh

$ sudo systemctl restart nginx
[sudo] password for jsmith:
caption: chown sets who owns a file; sudo runs one command as root, logged, without a root login.
